verdict.notes: Source-only review recognizes current cache isolation and offers conditional future hardening. Extra batch/session/audit-eviction/correctness findings are supported. Factory resolution, restart state ownership, cache eviction and full host lifecycle are incomplete. Audit argument-name inventory is inaccurate; journal does preserve names. Session refresh can be achieved by closing/reopening valid own handles, though there is no sliding refresh API.
unsupported_gap_claims: A malformed `sid` has the same effect. — A malformed handle raises before the local try, but batch resolves the same sid before executing any item. A malformed sid supplied to batch therefore cannot cause the reported halfway-applied batch and lost earlier replies. Only if a valid handle expires during a running batch could earlier items apply. The assertion, scoped under the partial batch finding, overstates the malformed-sid effect.
false_assurance_claims: Journal and audit entries record argument names only, not values or tokens. — Journal records argument names; Audit has no argument-name field at all. Both omit bodies/tokens, but the combined affirmative inventory is inaccurate for Audit. This is a minor field inventory error, not credential leakage.
